title: Pigment Raises $250M at $2.3B Valuation With Nvidia Backing
summary:
Scaleup Europe Fund led a fundraising round for Pigment, a French startup creating AI alternatives to standard business spreadsheets and slide decks. The investment totals $250 million and values the company at $2.3 billion, with participation from Nvidia. Pigment provides AI-powered tools for financial forecasting and the automated generation of business presentations to compete with Excel and PowerPoint.

The company is currently planning to bring on additional backers from Asia to support a geographic expansion of its operations. This move follows the rollout of its planning suite designed to automate data analysis and enterprise reporting workflows.
